meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查并修复 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 的安装健康状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果本地 LazyCodex 或 Codex 安装可能已过时或损坏
copy.tagline_en: Check and fix LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your local LazyCodex or Codex install may be stale or broken

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会检查本地 LazyCodex 与 Codex CLI 的安装，和最新源码对比，给出“通过/警告/失败”报告，每条结论都附命令输出或文件证据；诊断时只读取，不改动你的安装和配置，只提修复建议。
howto.when: 当你说到 LazyCodex、lazycodex-ai 等名称，或要求做安装健康/医生检查，或 Codex 在安装、更新或改配置后行为异常时触发。

say.text: 检查一下我的 LazyCodex 安装是否健康
say.note: Claude 会同步最新源码并逐项核验本地安装。

say.text: 我的 Codex 更新后行为异常，帮我诊断
say.note: Claude 会运行检查并给出证据和修复建议。

say.text: 对比本地安装和最新 LazyCodex 源码有没有偏差
say.note: Claude 会把安装的文件与最新源码比对，报告漂移。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude inspects local LazyCodex and Codex CLI installs against latest sources, returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with evidence for each verdict, and only reads—no changes to your install or config; it proposes remediations.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a health check/doctor, mention LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or say Codex behaves oddly after install/update/config change.

say_en.text: Check whether my LazyCodex install is healthy
say_en.note: Claude syncs latest sources and audits the local setup.

say_en.text: My Codex behaves oddly after an update—diagnose it
say_en.note: Claude runs checks and returns evidence plus fixes.

say_en.text: Compare my local install against the latest LazyCodex source
say_en.note: Claude diffs installed files against the source checkouts.
